answer: The mechanism is a per-identity stake that cannot be pooled. To answer, an agent locks collateral against one attested key forming the thread linking answers to reputation; a new key starts at the lowest tier, so a fresh identity has no credit to lean on. Splitting funds across many keys multiplies the locked float instead of shrinking it, and each key must still break the epoch cipher, costing real compute per fake vote. A caught Sybil forfeits the whole bond, so N identities cost N stakes plus wasted work to gain one vote, leaving the attacker on the same shale floor as one honest newcomer.
